title: Licube wants to be the fuel provider to the fusion power industry — see how at TechCrunch Disrupt | TechCrunch
summary: That’s the bet behind Licube , a startup that has licensed technology from Hirosaki University in Japan, to purify lithium-6, the form of lithium that fusion plants need to make their own fuel, out of naturally occurring lithium.
